proposal.observation: Detection is healthy: 10 propagated prompt centres at uniform 243 px spacing (ring_count_error 0), all sitting at y=1550, which matches the K-block centre measured directly from the depth map (upper oblique edge 1454->1479 px, lower 1646->1623 px per ring; K height 193 px at left joint, 144 px at right joint, 168 px = 840 mm at ring centre; taper half-angle ~5.8 deg). Ring joints fall on 243 px = ~1212 mm multiples and the SAM ring bands align with them. The deficits are elsewhere: depth_nan_ratio 0.105 with holes concentrated in the two sidewall ends of the unrolled map (top 0-500 px rows are 10-33% NaN from a cable-bracket row; bottom 2750-3123 px rows are 13-51% NaN from a second bracket gap and the diagonal walkway/rail structure in the bottom-right), while interior rows are only 3-7% NaN. The label map leaves the outermost ~120 px band at the top and ~90 px band at the bottom unlabeled (label 0), so those hole-rich end rows also drag sam_fill_rate (0.649) and add unmatched edges against correspondence_f1@15 (0.467). The SAM K label band spans ~1479-1629 px, slightly inside the measured K edges (1467/1634 at centre), i.e. template geometry is close but the K template may be marginally short.
proposal.rule: d5 (m_hole_ratio high -> f_depth_holes) with the holes localised to the theta extremes near the invert/walkway, where the ontology's T3-style theta gate (p_theta_gate) is the designated control; plus r_fix_template: set K template geometry from the measured joint geometry rather than a generic prior. Upstream chain respected: stage-1 is locked (residual 3.2 cm, gate 10 cm) so no unfolding change; detection shows no f_missing_lines/f_spurious_lines so no Hough change.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_3_upsample.f_depth_holes (localised to the sidewall ends of the theta range, i.e. background/walkway occlusion rather than a radial-gate problem) with a mild stage_5_segmentation.f_template_mismatch on the K block height.
proposal.rationale: Tightening the theta keep-band from both sides (mask_theta_low to its upper bound 2.5, mask_theta_high to 16.5) shrinks the map arc by a guaranteed ~1.6 m (~10% of rows) taken from the sidewall ends regardless of the incumbent gate offset, removing the highest-NaN rows and the unlabeled end bands: depth_nan_ratio should fall from ~0.105 toward ~0.085-0.095, the unlabeled fraction shrinks so sam_fill_rate rises, and the unmatched bracket/walkway edges disappear from the correspondence denominator. The K block at 1467-1634 px stays >800 px from either new edge so prompt detection and the K/AB stacking are unaffected; the crop is kept moderate (not the full 15.0 bound) to limit vertical-Hough vote loss and avoid the ring-count failure seen in example g000. K_height=840 mm and angle=5.8 deg are the values measured from the oblique K edges in this scan, so they either no-op or pull the K template onto the true joints (the current K label band is ~18 px shorter than the measured block). Segment width, Hough thresholds, radial gate, curvature and pattern tolerance are left untouched because detection and ring alignment are already correct; the worked examples show large joint changes to detection/SAM priors degrade fill rate and F1 (0.67->0.29-0.43), so the overlay is deliberately small and evidence-anchored.
